title: Influence of Data Collection Mode on Self-Report Validity of Asthma Therapy Adherence
brief_summary: This study will examine how the assessment mode influences the validity of self-reported adherence to asthma therapy. Self-reported adherence to asthma therapy data will be collected using one of three randomized assessment modes (interview, computer, or telephone).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of asthma
* Under a provider's care for asthma
* Prescribed daily inhaled corticosteroids (by metered dose inhaler \[MDI\]) at least 2 times a day
* Speaks English
* Otherwise in good general health

Exclusion Criteria:

N/A
